Position: Chairman, President, and CEO of Home Depot
Joined Home Depot: 2000
CEO Since: March 2022
sentences.text: Decker, with the company since 2000, became chief executive in March 2022 and also holds the chairman and president titles, a combined-role structure.

sentences.quote: His strategy focuses on omnichannel retail, supply chain innovation, and professional customer growth.
sentences.text: Execution has centred on three priorities: supporting associates, a frictionless interconnected customer experience, and winning with Pros; results have been pressured by housing, with fiscal 2025 net earnings of $14.2 billion, or $14.23 per diluted share, against $14.8 billion and $14.91 in fiscal 2024.

Capital allocation follows a stated order of reinvestment first, then the quarterly dividend, then buybacks, with $3.7 billion of fiscal 2025 capex and $9.2 billion returned via dividends after a 2.2% increase, while repurchases were paused in March 2024 for the SRS acquisition.
